note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description alone — the game is a day old and nothing here was checked in play. Where the description pins no place or step down, the guide says so plainly.

sources.exophase_label: Exophase — the official trophy list (name, description and grade)
sources.psnprofiles_label: PSNProfiles — PSN's progress target where the list tracks a count

roadmap.title: Land in Leonida
roadmap.summary: Play the opening and Chapters 1–2, and start the two big exploration counters early — they tick up as you travel, so the sooner you start, the less backtracking later.

roadmap.title: The story, chapter by chapter
roadmap.summary: Chapters 3–4, the named story missions, the character strands and the stranger missions. Nothing here is missable — just play the story and answer every marker you see.

roadmap.title: Do these before the finale
roadmap.summary: The trophies that need your partner beside you, and the two one-off moments the descriptions read as set pieces. Do them while you still can — keep a manual save before the story's final stretch.

roadmap.title: Leonida's playground
roadmap.summary: Activities and skills: stunts, races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, meditation, hunting, combat and heists. Work through them between story beats.

roadmap.title: Collect, spend, count
roadmap.summary: Collectible sets, the long counters, money and property — plus the three vague ones, which pop from playing the world rather than from any single step.

roadmap.title: The platinum
roadmap.summary: Finish the final mission, push completion to 100%, and the platinum pops. If anything is left, the checklist shows exactly what it is.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, so there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order — story first, the missable moments before the finale, then activities and collectibles — and this one takes care of itself. Source: the official list on Exophase; the count of 54 is the list itself.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end — it is the game's first mission, so this trophy is unmissable and comes in your first session. Use it to learn the controls: driving, shooting and switching between Lucia and Jason. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 and this pops with the chapter-complete screen. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just play the story. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: story progress only, no side requirement. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Keep playing the story; the chapter trophies stack up as the plot moves into Vice City proper. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. By now you are deep into the story — the trophy is automatic with chapter completion. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. This is the story's last beat and the gold that caps the campaign; it cannot be missed, but it does close the story, so do the missable trophies in phase 3 of the roadmap first. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. A story mission — follow the mission marker when it appears and finish it; if you fail, mission retry lets you go again. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission in the story; the trophy is for finishing it, not for a particular approach, so play it your way. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission; finish it and the trophy pops. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — the name hints at a big set piece, but the requirement is only to finish the mission. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A takedown at Vice City International Airport; finish the mission and the trophy is yours. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission; finish it. The name suggests heavy weather or heavy firepower — either way, completion is all that counts. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. This is the long grind behind the platinum: every story mission, stranger strand, collectible set, activity and challenge the game counts. Use this guide's checklist as the map — when every other trophy is done, this one should be close. The in-game stats screen shows your percentage, so check it before the final push. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near misses, long airtime and clean landings — the game counts them as you play, so this builds up naturally if you drive fast and take ramps. To farm it, find a jump you can hit repeatedly and keep landing cleanly. Source: the official description on Exophase; the count of 250 is PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types; sample one of each — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a shooting-range round, a drone race, a bowling game, a meditation spot, a hunting trip and a stunt. You don't need to win or finish them all, just try each once. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 9 types are the game's activity list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the range's courses; gold each one. Practice a course until you know its targets, then chase the gold time or score — the range lets you retry a challenge as often as you like, so none of them is missable. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 42-challenge count is PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone-race spots; win one race at each. Learn each course's racing line first — a clean run beats a fast, crashing one — then go for the win at all 14. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 14 locations are PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Twenty distinct race events, any kind — street, off-road, boat or air, whatever the game offers. You need 20 different ones, so don't grind the same race; work through the race list and tick them off. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him — watch the bite, set the hook promptly and keep the line tension in the safe zone. If you lose, challenge him again. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet through to its end — pick the shortest game on the machine and finish one full run. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Play Andy's strand through to its last mission and finish it. Character strands unlock as the story goes on, so keep checking for Andy's marker between story missions. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as the other character finales: follow Kenton's strand to its end. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Finish Billy's strand — its last mission is the trophy. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions are the question-mark encounters on the map; finish 8 full strands, not just the first mission of each. Explore between story beats and answer every stranger marker you see. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Finish Randy's strand to its last mission. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Finish Tyrone's strand to its last mission. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. There are 18 meditation spots; sit and meditate at each one. They are quiet places with a view — explore the map's scenic points and use the prompt when it appears. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 18 spots are PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt asks for one specific animal — track it in the wild, take the shot cleanly and bring it back. Hunting needs patience: move quietly, watch the wind and the tracks. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida in sets; finish any 3 full sets. Pick up every card you spot and use this guide's checklist to track which sets are close to done. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-and-tag activity — do it at 100 different spots across the state. It ticks up as you travel, so fold it into exploring: whenever you are somewhere new, WAiNK It. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 100-location count is PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's small objectives scattered across activities — finish any 50. They accumulate as you play everything else, so this one mostly takes care of itself by the end. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you — do it while Lucia is freely available, before the story's final stretch, in case partner activities thin out later.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together — break line of sight, hide, and wait for the stars to clear. Do it while your partner is freely available, before the story's final stretch. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missable_note: Needs your partner beside you, and three shops in a row — do it while Lucia is freely available, before the story's final stretch.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between them. Do it while your partner is freely available. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles — each new one you get into counts. Steal, borrow or buy your way through the traffic: sports cars, trucks, boats, bikes and anything with wheels. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger Combat Focus — the slow-mo aiming mode — in a firefight with at least five enemies close together, and drop all five before it ends. Pick a busy shootout, wait for the group to bunch up, then activate it. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missable_note: Reads like a one-off set piece in the official description — do it at the first chance and keep a manual save before story missions around the airport.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport by air without a scheduled flight — steal a plane and take off. This reads like a one-off moment, so do it the first time you get near the airport with a plane in reach, and keep a manual save before story missions around the airport. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are tanks — get into a fight with them, whether by stealing one or by facing them at a high wanted level, and survive the heat. The description names no place or step, so any run-in with a Rhino counts. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case a jewelry store, go in quiet, take the goods and get out before anyone spots you — no alarms, no witnesses calling the cops. If you are spotted, leave and try again. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Crack five bank vaults and get away clean each time — five separate robberies, each ending with your escape. Plan the getaway before you go in. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop an armored truck, take its cash and get away. Trucks run set routes — watch one, block it, crack it open and lose the heat. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state — the counter ticks up as you set foot, or wheels, somewhere new. Drive the whole map, coast to swamp, and this fills in as you play. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 52 areas are PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; hit one illegal operation run by each of them. Learn which gang holds which turf and work through all nine. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 9 gangs are PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — a quiet moment, no combat needed. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_note: Reads like a one-off set piece in the official description — do it when you first get the chance and keep a manual save handy.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front and out the other side, the way the old games did it. This reads like a one-off set piece, so do it when you first get the chance and keep a manual save handy. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — the follow-through is the delivery, so finish a full game there. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is vague on purpose — a partnership moment that lands with the public. Keep playing the story and partner content; it should pop from a story or social beat. No specific step is pinned down by the official description yet. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). Make choices across the game — PSN tracks a count to 500. Dialogue and story choices add up over a full playthrough, so keep choosing and this ticks along in the background. Source: the official description on Exophase; the count of 500 is PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail at something, then succeed on the second try — a retry that lands. If it doesn't pop naturally, retry any activity you just failed and finish it on the next attempt. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange — a weird event, an odd encounter, something out of the ordinary in Leonida. Keep your eyes open while exploring; strange things happen to players who wander. No specific trigger is pinned down by the official description yet. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving past on a bike or in a car, hit someone with a melee attack and knock them down. A drive-by swing, not a gun — get close, swing, and keep driving. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. Keep robbing, keep laundering — it adds up across the game. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy things — clothes, weapons, cars, food, anything sold in a shop — until $100,000 is spent in total. Big purchases like cars move this fast. Source: the official description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida — each one is a place to store your vehicles. Save up, then work through the property listings. Source: the official description on Exophase; the 8 garages are PSN's target as listed on PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register 10 vehicles you own or find — open the app, pick a vehicle and register it, ten times. Source: the official description on Exophase.
